software_engineer.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Python / Cloud)
software_engineer.job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable distributed systems and REST APIs. Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in Python, Django, or FastAPI
- Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL and caching with Redis
- Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Solid foundation in microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and unit testing (pytest)
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
- Collaborative mindset, mentoring junior engineers, and participating in agile/scrum processes.
